en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a snowy alpine landscape. Gently rounded, treeless slopes fill most of the scene, covered in deep snow. In the foreground are several snow‑laden conifer trees casting long shadows. On the left stands a small alpine chalet or hut partly buried in snow. Thin poles or fence posts with wire lines run across the slopes, and faint ski tracks or a simple tow line are visible climbing toward a ridge on the right. The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of vintage postcards.
